en: Kilesadukādi, Sanidassanattika (The Triplet on Visibility, beginning with the Dyad on Defilements)

Dependent on a state that is not subject to defilement, is visible, and offers resistance, there arises a state that is not subject to defilement, is visible, and offers resistance, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under resultant condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
